description_en: Counts the number of gateways that match the specified filter conditions under the current user account
description_zh: 统计当前用户账号名下符合过滤条件的网关数量
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan count-gateways --iot-instance-id example-string --online-state ONLINE --fuzzy-gw-eui 123456 --fuzzy-city '杭州' --fuzzy-name name --freq-band-plan-group-id 123 --is-enabled false --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CountGateways

parameters.help_en:
Filters gateways by online or offline status.

If this parameter is not specified, gateways are not filtered by online status. Valid values:
ONLINE
OFFLINE
parameters.help_zh:
网关在离线状态过滤。

若未传入此参数，则不限制在线状态。可取值为ONLINE和OFFLINE
parameters.name: online_state

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy match filter for city name
parameters.name: fuzzy_city

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy match filter for gateway name
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

parameters.help_en: Filters gateways by frequency band plan group ID
parameters.name: freq_band_plan_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters gateways by enabled or disabled status.

If this parameter is not specified, gateways are not filtered by enabled or disabled status
parameters.help_zh:
网关启停用状态过滤。

若未传入此参数，则不限制启停状态
parameters.name: is_enabled

Data.description_en: The total number of gateways that match the filter conditions
Data.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的网关总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
